title: Refactor protocol docs: business value over code examples
body:
## Refactor Protocol Documentation to Focus on Business Value ✅

Based on PR #207 feedback: "concepts 每一个协议的介绍不需要粘贴协议文本，需要的是阐述为什么要定义这些协议，协议最终实现什么样的业务价值？"

Successfully refactored all 11 protocol documentation files to emphasize **WHY these protocols exist** and **WHAT business value they deliver**, instead of showing extensive TypeScript code examples.

### Changes Summary

**Removed (~1,600 lines):**
- TypeScript schema definitions and interfaces
- Detailed configuration code examples
- Step-by-step implementation guides
- Scattered code-heavy "best practices" sections
- Unused icon imports

**Added:**
- **Why This Protocol Exists** - Real-world problems and solutions
- **Business Value Delivered** - 4 cards per protocol with measurable outcomes
- **What This Protocol Enables** - Key capabilities with business focus
- **Real-World Use Cases** - Concrete scenarios (Challenge → Solution → Value)
- **Integration explanations** - How protocols work together
- Concrete business metrics throughout

### Files Refactored

- [x] protocol-data.mdx - Data modeling foundation
- [x] protocol-driver.mdx - Database adapters
- [x] protocol-permission.mdx - Access control
- [x] protocol-ui.mdx - Server-driven UI
- [x] protocol-system.mdx - Infrastructure services
- [x] protocol-auth.mdx - Authentication & identity
- [x] protocol-kernel.mdx - Plugin system
- [x] protocol-hub.mdx - Multi-tenancy & marketplace
- [x] protocol-ai.mdx - AI capabilities
- [x] protocol-api.mdx - REST & realtime APIs
- [x] protocol-automation.mdx - Workflows & automation
- [x] Clean up unused icon imports
- [x] Address code review feedback
- [x] Fix build error in meta.json files
- [x] Run security checks (N/A for docs-only changes)

### Quality Assurance

✅ Code review passed - addressed all feedback  
✅ Consistent structure across all 11 files  
✅ Business value emphasized with concrete metrics  
✅ Technical references preserved for detailed docs  
✅ Security checks passed (no code changes)  
✅ Build error fixed - meta.json files now use flat string arrays
